section:
### Comparison of the arms

Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. All data for this comparison were collected at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.

Table 3. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 13.6 | 6.8 | 700 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 14.3 | 7.2 | 700 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 13.9 | 7.0 | 700 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 13.9 | 7.0 | 700 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
